subject: World Languages

units.title: Communication: Communicate effectively in the target language in order to function in a variety of situations and for multiple purposes

topics.title: Interpretive Communication: Learners understand, interpret, and analyze what is heard, read, or viewed on a variety of topics

subtopics.title: Interpretive Communication: Learners understand, interpret, and analyze what is heard, read, or viewed on a variety of topics

outcomes.text: What can I understand, interpret, or analyze in authentic informational texts?
What can I understand, interpret, or analyze in authentic fictional texts?
What can I understand, interpret, or analyze in conversations, discussions, and presentations?

topics.title: Interpersonal Communication: Learners interact and negotiate meaning in spoken, signed, or written conversations to share information, reactions, feelings, and opinions

subtopics.title: Interpersonal Communication: Learners interact and negotiate meaning in spoken, signed, or written conversations to share information, reactions, feelings, and opinions

outcomes.text: How can I exchange information and ideas in conversations?
How can I meet my needs and address situations in conversations?
How can I express, react to, and support preferences and opinions in conversations?

topics.title: Presentational Communication: Learners present information, concepts, and ideas to inform, explain, persuade, and narrate on a variety of topics using appropriate media and adapting to various audiences of listeners, readers, or viewers

subtopics.title: Presentational Communication: Learners present information, concepts, and ideas to inform, explain, persuade, and narrate on a variety of topics using appropriate media and adapting to various audiences of listeners, readers, or viewers

outcomes.text: How can I present information to narrate about my life, experiences, and events?
How can I present information to give a preference, opinion, or persuasive argument?
How can I present information to inform, describe, or explain?

units.title: Culture: Interact with intercultural competence and understanding

topics.title: Cultural Products, Practices, & Perspectives: Learners use the language to investigate, explain, and reflect on the relationship between the products, practices, and perspectives of the cultures studied

subtopics.title: Cultural Products, Practices, & Perspectives: Learners use the language to investigate, explain, and reflect on the relationship between the products, practices, and perspectives of the cultures studied

outcomes.text: How can I examine the relationship between cultural products and perspectives?
How can I examine the relationship between cultural practices and perspectives?

topics.title: Intercultural Competence: Learners demonstrate intercultural competence when interacting with others

subtopics.title: Intercultural Competence: Learners demonstrate intercultural competence when interacting with others

outcomes.text: How can I demonstrate intercultural competence when interacting with others in and from another culture?

units.title: Connections: Connect with other disciplines and acquire information and diverse perspectives in order to use the target language to function in academic and career-related situations

topics.title: Making Connections: Learners build, reinforce, and expand their knowledge of other disciplines while using the language to develop critical thinking and to solve problems creatively

subtopics.title: Making Connections: Learners build, reinforce, and expand their knowledge of other disciplines while using the language to develop critical thinking and to solve problems creatively

outcomes.text: How can I broaden my knowledge, while using the target language, to help me develop critical thinking and solve problems creatively?

topics.title: Acquiring Information and Diverse Perspectives: Learners access and evaluate information and diverse perspectives that are available through the target language and its cultures

subtopics.title: Acquiring Information and Diverse Perspectives: Learners access and evaluate information and diverse perspectives that are available through the target language and its cultures

outcomes.text: How can I explore diverse perspectives through the target language and culture(s)?

units.title: Comparisons: Develop insight into the nature of language and culture in order to interact with intercultural competence in the target language

topics.title: Language Comparisons: Learners use the target language to investigate, explain, and reflect on the nature of language through comparisons of the target language and their own

subtopics.title: Language Comparisons: Learners use the target language to investigate, explain, and reflect on the nature of language through comparisons of the target language and their own

outcomes.text: How can I compare the nature of my language to another language?

topics.title: Cultural Comparisons: Learners use the target language to investigate, explain, and reflect on the concept of culture through comparisons of the cultures studied and their own

subtopics.title: Cultural Comparisons: Learners use the target language to investigate, explain, and reflect on the concept of culture through comparisons of the cultures studied and their own

outcomes.text: How can I use language to compare another culture to my own?

units.title: Communities: Communicate and interact with intercultural competence in order to participate in multilingual communities at home and around the world

topics.title: School and Global Communities: Learners use the language both within and beyond the classroom to interact and collaborate in their community and the globalized world

subtopics.title: School and Global Communities: Learners use the language both within and beyond the classroom to interact and collaborate in their community and the globalized world

outcomes.text: How can I use language to collaborate and interact with others?

topics.title: Lifelong Learning: Learners set goals and reflect on their progress in using languages for enjoyment, enrichment, and advancement

subtopics.title: Lifelong Learning: Learners set goals and reflect on their progress in using languages for enjoyment, enrichment, and advancement

outcomes.text: How can I set reasonable goals and reflect on my progress in using languages for my enrichment?
